_header: PLANTED SYNTHETIC — POSITIVE CONTROL — NOT A MEASUREMENT OF VLD VALUE ON REAL DECISIONS.
_stage: Stage 1: 50 PURCHASING instances (30 strong + 10 moderate + 10 controls)
_design_notes: All companies, shops, events, records, quantities, policies, outcomes and factor values are synthetic. Evidence is available at alert arrival t0; no post-disposition outcome is used. Product and food acceptance windows are fictional local policies, not regulatory advice.

The named multihop_scenario_spec_v2.md was referenced by the prompt but was not attached. The supplied prompt is the available authority. Required fields are preserved and additive metadata makes assumptions and checks explicit; compatibility with an unseen strict additionalProperties=false schema is not claimed.

The supplied action profiles are ranges, not actual learned centroids or a distance metric. This fixture uses each range midpoint and unweighted squared Euclidean distance solely as an explicit reproducible proxy. No claim is made about the live scorer, learned weights, conservation state or production recommendations.

Range membership is illustrative rather than mandatory. In particular the near-expiry template cannot start at shelf_life >=0.50 and move by >=0.50 except at the endpoints; starting slightly below that profile range permits the mandated shift while retaining a unique order_standard nearest centroid. Economics may also start below the standard profile cost range; all surface nearest-action assignments are checked.

Template 4 contains a polarity conflict. The factor definition is retained: high cost_efficiency means expensive or inefficient. Hidden total costs therefore INCREASE this factor by at least 0.40; the template HIGH-to-LOW direction is corrected. Quality falls by at least 0.40. Supplier reliability is not silently changed in this template.

Supplier reliability means the synthetic score for usable on-time/in-full fulfilment of the imminent exact-item order. Historic punctuality can remain high while allocated releasable supply is low. Quality means fitness for the ordered purchase specification; cosmetically sound wrong items can have low suitability.

shelf_life is an expiry-risk factor: high means little usable life remains, low means ample remaining life. It is not days of inventory cover. Emergency cases explicitly separate remaining life from the small quantity of usable inventory.

Near-expiry cases concern short-dated incoming offers. Reduced orders fill a positive remaining usable-window gap; deferrals have no uncovered gap before confirmed fresh supply. Current expired or held stock is never counted as usable inventory. Short shelf life by itself is not a reason to stop replenishment.

Actions describe the primary next purchase decision. Existing segregation or holds are stated where relevant; this six-action label set does not purport to encode the entire quality-incident response. switch_supplier uses a timely ordinary approved alternative; emergency_order requires an approved expedited route because all ordinary routes miss depletion.

rho_planted has no definition in the attachment beyond labels. This file adopts a declared conditional binary routing-score reliability interpretation. Values are target simulation parameters, not observed frequencies. Moderate cases have less reliable steering cues; their factor shifts remain large to preserve the universal two-factor rule.

rho=0.50 does not imply six-action accuracy 1/6. Under the specified independent two-gate score-following reference policy, full-path probability is rho squared, or 0.25 at rho=0.50. Final action accuracy also depends on evidence, priors, failure behavior and fallback policy and is left null. 1/6 applies only to a uniform random guess over six actions.

Five rho=0.50 cases are retained as requested uninformative routing-cue checks. Their evidence remains actionable; they are not no-information controls and no claim that VLD must equal chance is encoded.

This is an evaluator/oracle fixture, not a safe initial model prompt. Gold actions, scenario names, descriptive narratives, factor updates, full evidence, routing pairs, complete graphs and validation fields must be hidden until allowed by the evaluation contract.

Conditionality is implemented through a first record revealing a binding key for the second read. Some paths are direct entity chains; others are keyed graph joins through the item. This does not establish an advantage over relational joins or key-value lookup, or prove folded/entangled boundary geometry. A fixed breadth policy can resolve a case if it acquires the requisite keyed records within budget.

Graph edges are schema-level record associations: QUALITY_HOLD_ON points to a QA/release record and does not by itself assert an active hold; DEMAND_SPIKE_ON points to a mapped demand event whose returned schedule may cancel the earlier expectation. Read payloads determine current status. Both traversal directions are permitted and each branch graph path is checked.

Misleading branches are truthful but unresolving aggregate or prior views already reflected in the surface scores. They consume budget, do not advance the key path and never overwrite a verified scoped factor. Their zero factor change is intentional; the >=0.30 rule applies to correct hops.

The 50 instances deliberately overrepresent hidden reversals and repeat eight core templates. Template cues and action imbalance can inflate evaluation results. Split by template or construction family, mask oracle fields, report action and template baselines, and do not interpret planted surface failure as real deployment prevalence or customer value.

No category is assigned only one action. Three standard-order flat controls exactly reuse the six-factor vector and alert category of a hidden-reversal case. Their item, store and visible operational context differ; these are numeric shortcut checks, not complete counterfactual pairs or proof that any possible surface classifier must fail.

_proxy_scoring_contract.distance: sum over six factors of (value - midpoint)^2; lower is nearer
_proxy_scoring_contract.ties: No winning ties in this fixture; an evaluator must abstain/report ties rather than silently choose an action.
_proxy_scoring_contract.update_rule: A resolving read replaces exactly its factor. Other factors remain unchanged. An unresolved aggregate read makes no update. Do not map raw evidence quantities directly to these hand-planted normalized values.
_proxy_scoring_contract.boundary_rule: Every nonflat surface winner differs from ground truth. The full ordered path reaches ground truth; every proper subset of its factor updates fails to do so. All nonflat cases have two distinct factors shifting by at least 0.30.

_evaluation_contract.initial_graph_view: Only the alert item identity and explicitly public branch descriptors. Do not serialize full graph_nodes, graph_edges, record_scope_key or future branch identifiers to the policy.
_evaluation_contract.opaque_ids: IDs are evaluator handles. If exposing scenario IDs, map them to opaque randomized identifiers per run so block and template numbering do not leak construction labels.
_evaluation_contract.read_semantics: Read each eligible branch at most once, debit read_cost even for a foil, require prerequisite_branches and exact returned key bindings, then return evidence_found, factor_enriched, factor_new_value, value_application, reveals_bindings, traversed graph_path and newly eligible public branch descriptors. Keep evaluative narration private.
_evaluation_contract.access_control: The second pair is undiscoverable and inaccessible until the correct first read returns its scope key. Guessing an unread record ID or key must not bypass this gate. A failed request returns no evidence and cannot create a free read.
_evaluation_contract.graph_cost_unit: One read buys the named record lookup including traversal of its declared path; edge count is not read cost. First-read bindings are cached for the episode. No cross-episode cache.
_evaluation_contract.rho_cue_generator: At each reached paired gate, draw an independent Bernoulli(rho_planted). Give the relevant branch score 0.75 and its foil 0.25 on success; swap them on failure. Randomize presentation order independently. The generator and gold routing pairs are evaluator-private. This is an optional explicit synthetic noise intervention, not a measured scorer.
_evaluation_contract.rho_application_scope: Apply one draw per reached gate, rather than one draw for the entire two-hop episode. If the harness instead defines rho at episode level, rerun and relabel; do not reuse rho squared.
_evaluation_contract.reference_policy: For the analytical route-completion check only, follow the higher cue within each active pair. With budget two and two necessary reads, any foil prevents complete resolution. Completion probability is rho squared; this is not six-action accuracy.
_evaluation_contract.failure_handling: Track unresolved at budget exhaustion separately from incorrect. If a six-action prediction is forced, declare the fallback and count it; do not relabel unresolved as chance. After a detected current quality mismatch, absence of a complete purchasing path does not authorize using the wrong or held item.
recommended_comparators: fixed breadth with the same access gates and costs
required_metrics: action accuracy with declared unresolved/fallback handling
results by template, action, rho and block
_evaluation_contract.small_sample_limit: Five D cases do not estimate chance performance reliably; repeat randomized cue seeds and report uncertainty. Repeated seeds measure routing randomness on these cases, not diversity of real decisions.

_validation.interpretation: These counts are construction checks against planted labels, not independent accuracy or VLD benefit measurements.
